note: Kela-subsidised routes. Kela pays a share; the person pays an omavastuu. The cost note must state that plainly — 'subsidised' on its own tells nobody what they will pay. PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off.

entries.note: Requires three months of treatment contact and a psychiatrist's statement. The omavastuu figure in the cost note is a typical range and MUST be confirmed against Kela's current rates before launch. Role is 'care': this is the therapy itself, subsidised — the application process is how you reach it, not what it is. Re-read 2026-11-12: kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia unchanged: 'jos olet 16–67-vuotias', care for 'vähintään 3 kuukauden ajan', a B-lausunto or rehabilitation plan with a psychiatrist's assessment, the therapist 'täytyy olla Kelan hyväksymä', 'yksilöpsykoterapia 57,60 euroa/käyntikerta' and 'voit joutua maksamaan osan hinnasta itse'. Kela states no language the therapy is given in (its provider search has a per-provider 'Palvelun kieli'), so fi/sv/en is left as it was; open item for Amir. Decided by Amir 12.11.2026 (E18): Kela has no page stating the languages the therapy is given in: kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia, /rehabilitative-psychotherapy and /rehabiliterande-psykoterapi (read 12.11.2026) say nothing on it, since it depends on the therapist (Kela's provider search lists each one's 'Palvelun kieli'). The card shows 'not stated, so check the site' (languagesRef); languages stays fi/sv/en for ordering only. Decided by Amir 13.11.2026: languages from Kela's own page. Kela's provider search (kela.fi/hae-palveluntuottajaa, read 13.11.2026, linked as step 5 of kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia) makes 'Palveluntuottajan kielitaito' a required field for rehabilitative psychotherapy, with 'suomi', 'ruotsi' and 'englanti' among its options, and shows each therapist's 'Kielitaito'. So Kela states the therapy is found by the therapist's language, and fi/sv/en are stated languages again (languagesRef removed). Not seen: a result list, since the search's location list did not load on 13.11.2026 (Kela's banner reported a Microsoft services disruption); a reviewer can run the search with englanti to see the count. Not re-dated: on 13.11.2026 only the provider search was read, not kela.fi/kuntoutuspsykoterapia's age, cost and conditions, last read 12.11.2026. Amir 14.11.2026: each language links to Kela's own page in it (localUrls). Read 14.11.2026, all three state the card's facts: fi 'jos olet 16–67-vuotias', 'yksilöpsykoterapia 57,60 euroa/käyntikerta'; en 'if you are between 16 and 67 years of age', 'individual psychotherapy EUR 57.60/session'; sv 'om du är 16–67 år', 'individuell psykoterapi 57,60 euro/besök'; each names three months of care, a psychiatrist's statement and a Kela-approved therapist. Re-dated 14.11.2026.
